legend.0: Pure assertion—makes a truth-claim that could be denied.
legend.2: Balanced—asserts and points in equal measure.
legend.4: Pure ostension—directs attention without asserting anything.

legend.0: Collapses immediately—the self-application produces contradiction or emptiness.
legend.1: Oscillates—the self-application alternates between two states without settling.
legend.2: Degrades—the self-application produces a weakened or partial version of the original.
legend.3: Holds—the self-application reproduces the distinction without change.
legend.4: Strengthens—the self-application reveals the distinction to be more fundamental than before.
